comment: Q (727,2266) sits where the n1761 line runs into the square's top-right corner next to the n734 triangle's base corner. Measured edges: the line band's upper-left edge is at u 728 at v 2263-2264 and about u 726 at v 2266, so Q is about 1 px inside the band, at the same along-line position as P's first sample (730,2269); the triangle's right outer edge stays at u 724 down to v 2264 (Q 2-3 px outside it); the square's outer corner is about (727,2268-2270) (Q 2-4 px above it). On line ink by best estimate, but the margins are 1-3 px in merged ink.

Line ink (u 712-721 at v 2209) joins the circle's top (v 2210) with no white gap, so the first point is the circle center, about (713,2222). P and Q are both on the line above the junction (about 4 and 17 px up).
Line ink (v 2111-2113) joins the down triangle's top edge (v 2114) with no white gap, so the first point is the triangle centroid, about (712,2124). Both marks are on the line above it.

(2136,2218) is on the left stroke of the end triangle where the n734 line runs into it: the triangle's interior starts at u 2140 in rows 2215-2217 and its strokes are 5-6 px wide, so the stroke spans about u 2134-2139 there and P is inside it. An outer edge at u 2137-2139 (comment 1) would make the stroke 1-3 px wide, which does not fit.

(727,2259) is a dark pixel on the bottom row of the n734 band: at u 718-730 the band spans v 2251-2259 (center about 2255) and the white notch starts at v 2260. At that row the triangle's right edge is about u 723 and the n1761 diagonal's left edge about u 732, so this ink is the n734 line, not a gap and not n1761.

A white gap (u 724-729) separates the line from the triangle, so the first point is where the ink starts, the rounded tip at about (728-729,1828). Both marks are on the centerline inside the end cap of a line about 12 px wide: P about 3 px and Q about 5 px back from the tip. P is closer.

The n4695 line runs through the n3815 square and a stem (u 704-714, v 1754-1771) into the apex of the up triangle with no white gap, so the first point is the triangle centroid, about (708,1782). P and Q are both on the stem about 20 px above it.

A 1 px white column (u 721) separates the plus arm (ends u 720) from the line, so the first point is the start of ink, the rounded tip at about (722,1982). The line is 12 px thick (v 1976-1987); P is 4 px and Q 6 px inside the tip, both within the end cap. P is closer.

(714,2157) is dark: row 2157 ink runs u 713-729, continuous with the n1961 line (its upper-left end). The triangle apex begins at v 2159 (u 706-709) and is separated from the line by white at u 710-712, so P is on line ink, not in the gap; P is about 5 px off the centerline in a band about 12 px wide.

The thick line ends at u 2080 (P) with a white gap (u 2081-2088) before the last square (u 2089-2119, v 1547-1579, centered on the right frame), just as the n3815 line ends at u 2080 above it. But a stroke crosses the square's lower interior (v 1563-1567 from u 2096) and continues past its right side to u 2127 (Q) as a blob 10-12 px tall (line weight) centered on the curve's path (about v 1564). If that stroke is the drawn line overshooting the last symbol, Q is the end of ink; if it is symbol or print damage, P is. Mid-curve symbols on this page have no line inside them, and Q's end lies outside the plot frame (about x 253 vs frame about 249). Needs a person's call.

(2079,1558) is on line ink at the end of the main line (row 1558 ink runs to u 2080). (2126,1564) is on the stroke that crosses the last square and ends past it; whether that stroke is the drawn line is the open question of item 063.

A 3-4 px white gap separates the line from the first circle, so the first point is the end of ink; the end cap runs from (826,2067) to (831,2077) and the centerline ends at about (828,2073). P is about 2 px back along the line and 3 px off center, Q about 6 px back on the centerline; both lie inside the end cap of a 12 px line. P is closer.

Diamond spans u 1870-1910, v 3175-3208; its interior at v 3194 is u 1879-1897, center about (1888,3191). Q (1888,3194) is about 3 px from the center. P (1896,3194) is 8 px right of center but 2 px inside the right stroke (stroke starts at u 1898), so it is inside the symbol, not on the outline. Q is the better center.

The ink is a diamond about u 2200-2237, v 3275-3310, center (2218,3292), partly covered by the square above and the axis below. Diamond, not circle: pointed top vertex at (2223,3275) only 3 px wide (circles here start 8 px wide); interior narrows from 25 to 13 px over 6 rows below the widest row (45 degree sides; a circle would still be about 22 px); a pointed bottom vertex 6-7 px wide pokes below the axis at u 2215-2221 (circles on the axis do not); blunt side vertices like the clean diamond at (2158,3272). The square above is a separate symbol whose center is about 16 px above the marks.

Same ink as item 093: a diamond centered about (2218,3292) with a pointed top vertex inside the square above, 45 degree lower sides and a pointed bottom vertex below the axis; the square above is a separate symbol.
